title: Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
exact_target: For an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb Q$, the order of vanishing of $L(E,s)$ at $s=1$ equals $\operatorname{rank}E(\mathbb Q)$, the Tate–Shafarevich group is finite, and the leading coefficient satisfies the Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer formula.
